text: Implemented a frozen full-system Schur boundary over separate undamped objective curvature and physical displacement metric operators. It extracts and validates 6/12-parameter pose and pose-field blocks once, requires an explicit gauge convention, rebuilds/factors only the full damped pose block per damping attempt, applies exact matrix-free conditional products including non-diagonal damping cross blocks, recovers pose by triangular solves, recomputes the full damped residual, rejects apparent reduced convergence through ResidualRejected, and computes prediction from undamped H only. Added rank-aware data-only pose conditioning with pseudoinverse handling of null pose modes, conditional physical-metric whitening, explicit tested field directions to avoid production dense normals, and flags proving prior/damping exclusion. JVM and Scala.js PoseEliminatedSystemSuite: 5/5 each. Independent gates cover dense full-solve parity at two damping values, no source products while changing damping, Schur symmetry/dense parity, rank-deficient pose and unsupported field information, null-pose cross-coupling rejection, gauge declaration, 6/12 pose sizes, and singular pose factor failure. git diff --check passed.
